Urticaria is the sudden development of transient wheals (superficial dermal swellings) and angioedema (deep dermal swellings) or both. It can be acute or chronic, spontaneous or inducible. It can be induced by viral infections, bacterial infections, food allergies, drug allergies, colds, heat, or tight clothing, among other factors.

They are a group of disorders characterized by the formation of blisters on the skin and/or mucous membranes due to an abnormal immune response that damages the skin's structural components. Skin lightening (SL) is a practice where a person intentionally reduces the natural melanin pigmentation of their skin. The use of cosmetic, non-medical skin depigmentation is common among darker-skinned individuals globally.
